sections.Profile:
The "Super Tris" pinball machine, produced by C.E.A. Electronics Corporation in 1979, features a music-themed backglass that replicates the artwork from Gottlieb's 1972 "King Rock." The game includes two flippers, two pop bumpers, eight standup targets, a kick-out hole, and a messenger ball, with dual inlanes on both the left and right sides. The artwork for "Super Tris" was created by Gordon Morison.
